plan.title: Content ki lambai aur depth ko barhayein
plan.detail: Competitor sites par average 2288 words hain jabkay aap ki site par sirf 331 words hain. High-quality aur detailed content add karein taake page ki authority barhe aur search engines ko complete information mile.

plan.title: Relevant Images aur Alt Text add karein
plan.detail: Aap ki site par abhi 0 images hain jabkay muqabla karne wali sites par average 76 images hain. Content ke mutabiq high-quality visuals, infographics aur optimized Alt Tags add karein.

plan.title: Internal Linking Strategy ko mazeed mazboot karein
plan.detail: Aap ki site par sirf 5 internal links hain jabkay competitors ke paas 153 links hain. Site ke baaqi relevant pages aur articles ke links add karein taake link juice flow ho aur crawlability behtar ho.

plan.title: H2 Headings aur sub-topics ko barhayein
plan.detail: Content ko behtar tarike se organize karne ke liye H2 headings ko 5 se barha kar 10 ya us se zyada karein. Un mein relevant long-tail keywords target karein.

plan.title: Title Tag aur Meta Description ko optimize karein
plan.detail: Search engine results mein CTR barhane ke liye aik catchy Meta Title (under 60 characters) aur Meta Description (under 160 characters) likhein jis mein main keywords shamil hon.

plan.title: Schema Markup (Structured Data) add karein
plan.detail: Google aur baaqi search engines ko content samjhane ke liye relevant Schema Markup (jaise Article, FAQ, ya Product schema) implement karein.

plan.title: Nayi images ke sath Page Speed maintain rakhein
plan.detail: Aap ki mobile speed aur performance 100/100 hai jo ke behtareen hai. Nayi images add karte waqt unhein WebP format mein compress karein taake loading speed par koi farq na pare.
